scope: Finance Core physical foundation and accounting contracts. No API, UI, reports, consolidation engine, DOAF, transfer/payable workflows or Payroll (F1B/F1C/F1D/F2).
authorization: Not in F1A domain calls. The F1B application layer must authorize with TerritorialAuthority(data_type=FINANCE) and the D31 permissions BEFORE calling these services (permission before target resolution, F-06).

money.float: forbidden (TypeError / no FLOAT or DOUBLE column)

entry_lifecycle.subledger_entries: born POSTED inside the subledger transaction

J01.name: balanced posting
J01.rule: DRAFT->SUBMITTED->POSTED once; idempotent replay returns the same entry; different payload = IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; audit on the owner unit

J02.name: unbalanced posting denied
J02.rule: UNBALANCED / TOO_FEW_LINES / AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE; a failed subledger posting leaves no header, line or claim; CHECK ck_journal_lines_one_side

J03.name: posted immutable
J03.rule: every service path refuses a POSTED entry; header and lines byte-identical; only DRAFT lines are replaceable

J04.name: reversal contract
J04.rule: exact inverse, reason, OPEN period of the same unit, UNIQUE reversal_of_id, no reversal of a reversal, SUBLEDGER_OWNED

J05.name: accrual revenue
J05.rule: RECEIVABLE_RECOGNITION Dr RECEIVABLES / Cr INCOME (result, no cash) then SETTLEMENT Dr CASH / Cr RECEIVABLES (cash, no result)

J06.name: accrual expense
J06.rule: PAYABLE_RECOGNITION Dr EXPENSE / Cr PAYABLES then SETTLEMENT Dr PAYABLES / Cr CASH

J07.name: cash/bank balance derived
J07.rule: no balance column; balance = SUM POSTED lines; drafts never count; financial account posts to its own control account

J08.name: fixed-asset investment
J08.rule: Dr FIXED_ASSETS / Cr CASH|PAYABLES, immediate result 0; rubric mapping configurable, posted lines unchanged

J10.name: SEND no P&L
J10.rule: Dr INTERUNIT_CLEARING_OUT (counterparty, purpose) / Cr CASH|BANK of the origin only; TRANSFER_TOUCHES_RESULT; INTERUNIT_ONLY_BY_TRANSFER

J11.name: RECEIVE no P&L
J11.rule: Dr CASH|BANK / Cr INTERUNIT_CLEARING_IN of the destination only; one RECEIVE per transfer (UNIQUE)

J12.name: in-transit state
J12.rule: SEND without RECEIVE is consistent (CHECK), shows as in transit, no result; D-04A.3 example: perimeter revenue 100 000, never 160 000 / 200 000

J13.name: owner unit
J13.rule: owner unit NOT NULL + indexed; line unit = entry unit and account owned by the line unit (composite FKs); no department owner

J14.name: closed-period posting denied
J14.rule: unit close refuses postings/drafts of that unit only; reopen segregated; national close lists open units and is irreversible

J15.name: money precision
J15.rule: > 2 decimals rejected, float TypeError, CHECK ck_journal_lines_scale / limit, exact 0.10 + 0.20

J16.name: AOA-only
J16.rule: only AOA installed; any other entry or account currency CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED

C1.rule: two processes post the same entry: one OK, one ALREADY_POSTED; same idempotency key: one entry

C3A.rule: deterministic: CLOSE holds the period lock, POST observed in LOCK WAIT on accounting_periods; CLOSE OK, POST PERIOD_CLOSED, 0 header/line/claim, unit CLOSED, later posting refused

C3B.rule: deterministic: POST holds the period share lock, CLOSE observed in LOCK WAIT on accounting_periods; POST OK then CLOSE OK; entry POSTED before closed_at, balanced, later posting refused

mutation_probes.M2: allow mutation of a POSTED entry's lines
mutation_probes.M5: INTERUNIT_CONTROL clearing accounts installed as INCOME (revenue)
mutation_probes.M8: FIXED_ASSETS rubrics always mapped to expense
mutation_probes.M9: posting allowed in a closed unit period
mutation_probes.M10: financial balance stored as a column (source of truth)
mutation_probes.M12: second APPROVED budget allowed (approved guard removed)
